question: Which team won the 2021–22 I–League?
solution:
The correct answer is __Gokulam Kerala.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Gokulam Kerala __won the I-League title as it defeated TRAU 4-1 in the final match of the season in Kolkata.
 
• Gokulam as an I-League champion has qualified for the group stage of the AFC Cup next season, Asia's second-tier club competition.
 
• 
 
They also became the first club from the Kerala side to win the I-League title.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** Hero I-League:

 
• it was founded in the year 1996 as National Football League.
 
• The league was established in the year 2007 as I-League.
 
• It is organized by the All India Football Federation (AIFF).
 
• A total of 13 teams participates in the tournament.
